name: Citizenship by Marriage to a Kosovo Citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Law No. 03/L-034 on Citizenship, Article 11: a foreign spouse of a Kosovo citizen may naturalize with at least 3 years of a valid marital link plus at least 1 year of regular residence in Kosovo under a valid residence permit -- a substantially reduced bar compared to the standard 5-year naturalization residence requirement. The applicant must also meet the standard naturalization conditions on financial obligations and absence of pending criminal proceedings.
requirements.fix_path: Marry a Kosovo citizen, maintain the marriage for 3 years, accumulate 1 year of legal residence, and apply.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 1 year legal residence under a valid permit

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 1 year legal residence, within a marriage of at least 3 years

sources.title: Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo (government-hosted primary legal text) -- Law No. 03/L-034 on Citizenship, Article 11 (marriage-based naturalization)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kosovo). STATUS: DRAFT despite tier-1 sourcing, for the same reason as xk_citizenship_by_descent.json: the specific law cited (03/L-034, 2008) has been superseded twice, most recently by Law No. 10/L-023 (effective 6 May 2026), and this build could not independently confirm the 3-year/1-year marriage thresholds against the current operative text -- only the diaspora-reacquisition mechanics of the 2026 reform were confirmed. GENUINE FINDING: Kosovo's marriage route is a REDUCED-RESIDENCE NATURALIZATION variant (like Mali's and Niger's marriage-linked reduced tracks), not an automatic-acquisition mechanism -- there is no equivalent in Kosovo's law to Mali's automatic citizenship for foreign wives or Niger's one-year option. dual_citizenship_allowed set to true per Article 3, with the same supersession caveat as the other citizenship files.
